metadata.description: Testing concern area improvement: testing-fundamentals.md, component-harnesses.md, router-testing.md, e2e-testing.md

baseline_summary.description: iteration-3 baseline with old skill (1 run each, with_skill vs without_skill)

eval_6.note: addTodo used native fetch instead of HttpClient - skill lacked httpResource testing guidance

eval_4.note: Used resource({request:...}) instead of resource({params:...}) - wrong API

eval_6.note: Used deprecated TestBed.flushEffects() but addTodo correctly used HttpClient

improved_skill_benchmark.description: iteration-4 with improved skill (10 runs for eval 4, 3 runs each for evals 5 and 6)

eval_6_httpresource_service.note: Run 1 failed addTodo POST assertion: inlined service used reload() without HttpClient.post(). Runs 2 and 3 correctly used HttpClient.post() as guided by improved skill.

comparison.old_skill_vs_no_skill: Tied at 95.8% — old skill had no testing guidance for resource/httpResource
key_improvements: Eval 4 (resource component): 100% across all 10 runs (zero variance) — old skill also 100%, but without-skill was 87.5% due to wrong resource() API
Eval 6 (httpResource service): improved from 87.5% to 95.8% mean — the explicit HttpClient guidance fixed the native fetch antipattern in 2/3 runs
Eval 5 (custom harness): 100% across all 3 runs — both old skill and no-skill were also 100%, confirming models have solid CDK knowledge

notes: Eval 5 (custom harness) is non-discriminating: both with-skill and without-skill achieve 100%. Models have strong CDK ComponentHarness knowledge. The improved harness docs are still valuable for less common patterns (parallel(), HarnessPredicate) not tested here.

Eval 6 run-1 failure: the model inlined a TodoService with reload()-only addTodo despite the skill explicitly showing HttpClient.post() in the httpResource testing section. This is a known model inconsistency when generating inline service implementations for test files.
Zero variance on eval 4 across 10 runs demonstrates the improved testing-fundamentals.md reliably teaches the correct resource() testing patterns.
The without-skill baseline uses deprecated APIs (TestBed.flushEffects(), resource({request:...})) that the improved skill correctly avoids.
